catalog.title: Credor V2
catalog.note: JDM Credor catalogue from 1978, the later of the two 1978 editions, now printed as CREDOR, published by K. Hattori & Co. Men's gold dress quartz on scan pages 3-20 (p20 = the new 0.9 mm super-thin 9320 HGY models beside the 5931 ultra-thins), ladies' models on p22-33 (p33 = the 18K quartz pocket watch HNA-640) and steel / gold-accent RGE, RQD and KGT models on p35-37; p2, p8, p21, p26 and p34 are uncaptioned mood photos, p1 a text page and p0/p38 the covers, none of them records. Captions follow Credor V1: model number ("HHG 088" -> ref HHG-088), price in yen, case material (18KWG -> 18K WG, 18K, SS; two-tone cases as "18K WG / 18K"; RGE/RQD print none), crystal and stone-dial notes, the movement and case-dial number (7820<517-524> -> caliber 7820, caseDialCode 517-524; 58KQW is a family code and stays only in `code`) and, for strap models, the strap code kept in `bracelet`. On scan pages 3-6 the prices are labels pasted over the printed caption (higher than V1); the label is taken as the price, except HHG-048/844 on p6, which carry no label. The label on p5 #1 reads HFX 010 although the photo and 2620<510-025> are V1's HGE-010; kept as printed, conf medium. Three pages repeat Credor V1 pages outright and are NOT digitised here (their records live in 1978-1978-credor-v1): V2 p7 = top row of V1 p7 (HGE-060/884/881), V2 p9 = V1 p10 (HHR-608, HHG-098/948/100/964), V2 p12 = V1 p12 (HHG-140/180/994, HGF-020/814/604). Many other V2 records re-use V1 photos on new layouts; each says so in `notes`, with V1's scan page and price, and for those the dial and case description is carried over from the V1 record of the same watch.
catalog.method: vision transcription of 250 DPI renders of all 39 scan pages (Oct 2026), one record per pictured watch in caption order, verified against full-resolution caption crops and cross-checked with the PDF text layer (the scan wins where they differ).
